subject: Post-demo: stakeholder lanes, procurement checklist, champion enablement kickoff
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Arianna Lopez <arianna.lopez@stratusbank.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps (stakeholders, procurement asks, champion plan)

Hi Arianna / team — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Stakeholder lanes (what we heard)
   - Champion / product sponsor: Arianna Lopez (payments platform) — will lead internal sell-in
   - Economic buyer: Mark Davison, CFO (Arianna flagged) — needs ROI summary and 6-12 month cost model
   - Security / legal gating: IT security + procurement (SOC2, data residency, contract terms)

2) Procurement timeline
   - Procurement indicated an internal window of ~3 weeks to review pilot terms (Jacob T). Looks like earliest procurement greenlight target: March 31.

3) Asks from Stratus (from today’s call)
   - High-level SOC 2 Type II artifact + gap summary (one-pager)
   - Short data retention / data handling statement for regulated PII
   - Ballpark pricing for a 6-week pilot (expected token volume: ~500k tokens / month)

4) Redwood commitments / next steps
   - Sergio: share the demo deck, SOC2 summary, and mutual-action-plan template (attached).
   - Vanessa: draft a pilot MSA + one-off credit proposal to send to procurement.
   - Neha: stand by to provide security artifact answers and a short Q&A doc.
   - Arianna: confirm economic buyer (Mark) and procurement contact(s); confirm pilot start window.

Attachments: RDW-demo-deck-v2.pdf (slides), mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx

Open questions for internal team: Marissa — do we have latitude for a $10k pilot credit + 30-day opt-out clause? If so, Vanessa will include that in the MSA draft.

Thanks — aiming to have the MAP + MSA draft over to Arianna/Jacob by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0137

---

From: Arianna Lopez <arianna.lopez@stratusbank.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Turner <jacob.turner@stratusbank.com>, stratusbank-it@stratusbank.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps (stakeholders, procurement asks, champion plan)

Thanks Sergio — that recap is great and helpful. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Confirmed economic buyer = Mark Davison (CFO). I will intro Mark in a short thread once we have a one-page ROI and the pricing band.
- Procurement owner = Jacob Turner (cc’d). Jacob, our target is internal review by 03/31; pilot procurement will be handled under a one-time pilot MSA if acceptable.
- Security asks: we need the SOC2 summary and a short note on where tokenized / PII data is stored (data residency). Also any third-party subprocessors.

Ballpark for pilot pricing: if you can provide a simple price band (low/expected/high) and the $ credit amount you’re proposing that’ll help me sell it to Mark.

I’m happy to lead the internal sponsor chat but will wait for the one-page ROI and MAP so I can demo the quick win.

Arianna
Arianna Lopez
Director, Payments Platform | Stratus Bank
arianna.lopez@stratusbank.com

Thanks Arianna — good next steps. Quick internal notes and actions (looping in teams):

- Vanessa: please draft a pilot MSA (1x pilot, 6 weeks), include a $10k pilot credit and a 30-day opt-out/exit clause as discussed. Attach MSA draft to the MAP I’ll send to Arianna/Jacob.
- Neha: can you pull together the SOC 2 one-pager and a short data residency statement? Jacob will need that in procurement. I’ve attached the SOC2-type2-summary.pdf stub for reference — please fill gaps if needed.
- Marissa: can you confirm approval for the $10k pilot credit (we’ll show it as a promotional credit tied to the pilot deal id RDW-4521)? If yes I’ll include it in the pricing band.

Sergio (to external): Arianna / Jacob — attaching the demo deck and an internal MAP template. Vanessa will follow with an MSA draft and ballpark pricing later today.

Attachments: RDW-demo-deck-v2.pdf, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf

Best,
Sergio

Arianna / Jacob — draft MSA and pilot proposal attached for review. High level: 6-week pilot, up to 500k tokens/month, promotional credit $10,000, standard data processing addendum included.

Jacob — if procurement wants edits to the pilot clauses, we can redline. Also included a simple pricing band: $0.0025/token (low), $0.0035/token (expected), $0.005/token (high) — I can produce a 6-week cost example once you confirm expected consumption.

Marissa — please confirm approval on the pilot credit so I can mark this in the MAP.

Attachments: MSA-pilot-draft.docx
